scope: Additional read-only feasibility audit after the completed af7 standalone qualification. It does not run an ACT workflow, modify the original matrix refusal/report, change the 68 command-row counts or qualify later documentation.

method.logical_sizes_are_not_physical_reclaim: Docker system df and image Size are logical/differential. Actual per-cache-directory allocated blocks were measured by read-only du and mapped through cache-id/parent layer metadata. Per-directory allocation is at most an optimistic reclaim bound, not proof Docker can release every block.
method.first_probe: No capabilities; du had permission-denied warnings, so its incomplete sizes are not used
method.host_sudo: unavailable; host UID1000 cannot directly traverse Docker root
method.filesystem_contents_read: Only du/stat metadata plus Docker layer cache-id/size/parent metadata; no profile, cache credential, image environment or ordinary file contents.

conclusion: No demonstrably safe path found to run the supported full ACT matrix on the current root filesystem while preserving required images/tools/evidence and at least6GiB scratch. More root/Docker filesystem capacity or an adequately sized free owner-machine runner is required; do not weaken the measured preflight budget.
